questions.question: What is the primary function of an external earth connection or ground rod?

choices.A: Prevent static build up on power lines
choices.C: Reduce RF current flow between pieces of equipment
choices.D: Protect breaker panel from power surges

questions.question: When evaluating RF exposure levels from your station at a neighbor’s home, what must you do?

choices.A: Ensure signals from your station are less than the controlled maximum permissible exposure (MPE) limits
choices.B: Ensure signals from your station are less than the uncontrolled maximum permissible exposure (MPE) limits
choices.C: Ensure signals from your station are less than the controlled maximum permissible emission (MPE) limits
choices.D: Ensure signals from your station are less than the uncontrolled maximum permissible emission (MPE) limits

questions.answer: Ensure signals from your station are less than the uncontrolled maximum permissible exposure (MPE) limits

questions.question: Over what range of frequencies are the FCC human body RF exposure limits most restrictive?
When evaluating a site with multiple transmitters operating at the same time, the operators and licensees of which transmitters are responsible for mitigating over-exposure situations?

choices.A: Each transmitter that produces 20 percent or more of its MPE limit in areas where the total MPE limit is exceeded
choices.B: Each transmitter operating with a duty cycle greater than 25 percent
choices.C: Each transmitter that produces 5 percent or more of its MPE limit in areas where the total MPE limit is exceeded
choices.D: Each transmitter operating with a duty cycle greater than 50 percent

questions.answer: Each transmitter that produces 5 percent or more of its MPE limit in areas where the total MPE limit is exceeded

questions.question: What hazard is created by operating at microwave frequencies?

choices.B: The high gain antennas commonly used can result in high exposure levels
choices.C: Microwaves are in the frequency range where wave velocity is higher
choices.D: The extremely high frequency energy can damage the joints of antenna structures

questions.answer: The high gain antennas commonly used can result in high exposure levels

questions.question: Why are there separate electric (E) and magnetic (H) MPE limits at frequencies below 300 MHz?

choices.A: The body reacts to electromagnetic radiation from both the E and H fields
choices.B: Ground reflections and scattering cause the field strength to vary with location
choices.C: E field and H field radiation intensity peaks can occur at different locations

questions.question: What is meant by “100% tie-off” regarding tower safety?

choices.A: All loose ropes and guys secured to a fixed structure
choices.B: At least one lanyard attached to the tower at all times
choices.C: All tools secured to the climber’s harness
choices.D: All circuit breakers feeding power to the tower must be tied closed with tape, cable, or ties

questions.answer: At least one lanyard attached to the tower at all times

questions.question: What does SAR measure?

choices.C: The rate at which RF energy is absorbed by the body
choices.D: The rate of RF energy reflected from stationary terrain

questions.answer: The rate at which RF energy is absorbed by the body

questions.question: Which of the following types of equipment are exempt from RF exposure evaluations?

choices.A: Transceivers with less than 7 watts of RF output
choices.B: Antennas that radiate only in the near field
choices.D: Dish antennas less than one meter in diameter

questions.question: When must an RF exposure evaluation be performed on an amateur station operating on 80 meters?

choices.A: An evaluation must always be performed
choices.B: When the ERP of the station is less than 10 watts
choices.C: When the station’s operating mode is CW
choices.D: When the output power from the transmitter is less than 100 watts

questions.answer: An evaluation must always be performed

questions.question: To what should lanyards be attached while climbing?
Where should a shock-absorbing lanyard be attached to a tower when working above ground?

choices.B: To the belt of the fall-arrest harness
choices.D: To the next lowest set of guys
